rationale: High-cost claims (top 5%) are rare by definition, creating class imbalance. Using train_only threshold computation prevents test leakage. Feature selection now excludes all amount fields (billed_amount, allowed_amount, paid_amount, member_oop, cob_amount), the pre-computed high_cost_flag, and identifiers (claim_id, member_id) to prevent target leakage; using only submission-time features available when a claim arrives. Preprocessing fit on train only with standard scaling ensures logistic regression and random forest receive properly scaled inputs without data leakage. Random forest provides non-linear complementarity to logistic regression for ranking claims by high-cost risk. Model limitations caveat establishes appropriate baseline for interpreting results. Denominators and artifact citations support transparency and reproducibility.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage; these are post-adjudication amounts unavailable at claim submission. Added model_limitations caveat to write_report to appropriately contextualize model performance and limitations.
